name: 秋冬加厚连帽卫衣款
description: 加厚连帽保暖套头卫衣，贴袋暖手设计，多色百搭秋冬男装套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: light neutral gray studio backdrop #EFEFEF and clean white #FFFFFF alternate across shots, with flat cobalt blue #1E4FA3 and charcoal #3A424C info blocks as accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front or front-left key, gentle soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio backdrop, no visible tabletop texture
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines with letter-spaced magazine micro-labels
styleLock.iconSystem: uniform thin-line circular icons on solid white discs, single accent color #1E4FA3, single stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable garment scale across the set, model shots keep the garment fully visible and unobstructed, face never the focus
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent magazine-style menswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light neutral gray studio background #EFEFEF, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal info panel #3A424C, dark charcoal text #2D2D2D and one cobalt blue accent #1E4FA3; neutral tone; bright soft diffused studio lighting with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent white circular thin-line icon discs and flat rectangular info blocks; clean editorial menswear photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable garment scale and placement with layouts composed edge to edge; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 杂志刊头式开场，一秒建立秋冬上新氛围并赢得点击
shots.camera: full-body front view at eye level, model centered, garment fully visible and unclipped
shots.lighting: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front key with gentle fill, soft floor contact shadow
shots.background: light neutral gray seamless studio backdrop #EFEFEF with a thin white editorial frame border
shots.textZone: top masthead band: letter-spaced magazine masthead line 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D; one horizontal blue banner strip near the bottom carrying short copy 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: Magazine-style e-commerce hero of {product} worn by a generic male model, face turned away and cropped by the frame so it is never the focus. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Full-body front view at eye level, model centered, the garment fully visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright soft diffused studio lighting, front key with gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the figure. Light neutral gray seamless studio backdrop #EFEFEF with a thin white editorial frame border. The model and garment occupy 40-45% of the frame. The top masthead band carries a letter-spaced magazine masthead line 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, and one horizontal cobalt blue #1E4FA3 banner strip near the bottom carries short copy 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF, the two bands anchoring the editorial layout. 8K commercial quality. Negative: no visible face close-up, no brand logo, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra props, no cut-off garment, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 低角度仰拍强化版型气场，一秒传达核心卖点
shots.camera: photographed from a slightly low angle looking upward at a 3/4 angle, torso framing with the face cropped above the chin
shots.lighting: soft diffused daylight from the front-left, gentle shadows, 5500K
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with one flat cobalt blue accent block #1E4FA3
shots.textZone: one side: short headline 「{callout_1}」 and one sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D set on the clean white field
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn by a generic male model, torso framing with the face cropped above the chin. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a slightly low angle looking upward at a 3/4 angle to add presence. Soft diffused daylight from the front-left, 5500K, gentle shadows. Clean white background #FFFFFF with one flat cobalt blue #1E4FA3 accent block carrying a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」. The garment occupies 40-50% of the frame with the model and the type side balancing the composition edge to edge. Negative: no visible face, no more than one claim, no invented material or efficacy claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands covering the garment.

shots.intent: 微距放大面料纹理与厚度，证明保暖亲肤品质
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp, tight zoom on the fabric surface
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing weave texture and loft, controlled highlight
shots.background: the fabric surface fills the frame over a neutral matte field #F5F5F5
shots.props: three white circular thin-line icon discs
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.textZone: three white circular thin-line icon discs in a row, each with a short label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on its fabric surface showing weave texture and thickness. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing texture and loft, controlled highlight. The fabric fills most of the frame over a neutral matte field #F5F5F5, detail occupies 55-60% with only a slim natural margin around the texture. Three white #FFFFFF circular thin-line icon discs in a row, each with a short label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material composition or test data, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

Soft even studio light from the front, subtle fabric shadows. Clean white background #FFFFFF with one flat charcoal #3A424C info panel carrying a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one benefit line 「{selling_point_1}」. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with the charcoal info panel anchoring one side. shots.intent: 俯视平铺加属性标尺信息图，消除版型厚薄弹力疑虑

shots.background: light neutral gray #EFEFEF, one consistent backdrop
shots.textZone: one short colorway label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D under each garment
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product} shown in multiple colorways side by side, each colorway taken from the product reference and pinned by its own swatch, identical front 3/4 angle and identical lighting across all. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light consistent across every colorway, soft contact shadows. One consistent light neutral gray backdrop #EFEFEF. A short colorway label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D under each garment. provenance.notes: 从 7 张秋冬男装连帽卫衣详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源刊头字样、模特身份与长相、原文案、会员二维码与水印，产品一律以 {product} 占位，中文文案全部由 {callout}/{selling_point} 承接由商家回填，材质成分与检测数据未采信、以真实工艺细节与否定清单约束。
